title: How People Live a Week at a Time on the Mountain With the "World's Worst Weather"
intro: Every hour, day and night, someone walks out into 100 mph wind and ice on top of Mount Washington. Here's how the weather observers eat, sleep and work a week at a time.
asof_line: Figures from Mount Washington Observatory, CBS News and FOX Weather; current details as of 2026.
